faults.title: Squealing front brakes (Mk4)
faults.description: On the 2014-2021 Mk4, the brakes (mostly the fronts) can squeal, and Auto Express says this can be hard to cure.

faults.title: Excessive wind noise (Mk4)
faults.description: Badly fitting doors and seals can let a lot of wind noise into the cabin.

faults.title: Stained MB-Tex upholstery (Mk4)
faults.description: The artificial leather MB-Tex seat covering can discolour and look stained.

faults.title: AdBlue and steering recalls (Mk4)
faults.description: The Mk4 has had 20 recalls, including leaking AdBlue filler pipes on diesels, loss of power steering assistance, oil and fuel leaks, stalling and a steering column that could work loose.
